text:
Iris Park: Hey team, starting today as a product designer. Quick Qs: I accepted the org invite but the 'Design Roadmap - Q2' file shows Request access. Also where is the canonical research consent template and payment process?

Hannah Gomez: welcome Iris! :tada: I just re-sent the Figma invite and added you to the Designers group. If it still shows Request access, try signing in via Okta/SSO and open the link in a private window.

Iris Park: Still blocked, screenshot attached.

Maya (design-ops-bot): Iris Park provisioned to groups: Designers, Design-System.

Rob Li: Hey Iris  I run research ops. Consent templates and payment steps live in Notion > Research > Ops. Payments use Stripe Connect; for gift cards we use SendCards. Submit a payment request on the Research Ops page before scheduling sessions.

Hannah Gomez: Screenshot looks like a personal account conflict. Try: 1) sign out of Figma, 2) sign in with Okta SSO, 3) open the invite link. If that fails, @Hannah will add you by exact email.

Iris Park: Signed out and in via SSO, still Request access.

Hannah Gomez: OK adding you manually now. Also, handoff checklist is Notion > Design > Handoff and a Figma frame called 'Handoff Checklist' inside the Design System file. We expect tokens mapped, export slices named, and dev-mode comments.

Rob Li: For research shadowing, we have an "Observe & Debrief" slot Friday 2pm. New designers usually join the first two sessions. I'll add you to Lookback and the research calendar.

Iris Park: Thanks! Please add me to Lookback and drop the Notion links here when you can.

Maya (design-ops-bot): Iris Park added to Design Roadmap - Q2 file, Lookback, and Research Observers calendar.

Hannah Gomez: Links: Notion - Product Onboarding: https://notion.redwood.com/product/onboarding, Research Ops: https://notion.redwood.com/research/ops. DM me if you want the dev handoff template as markdown.

Iris Park: All good now, can open files. Appreciate the quick help  excited to jump in!
